---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "T"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: storm-plot
storms |>
  distinct(year, name) |>
  count(year) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Storms per Year",
    subtitle = "Counts based on the dplyr storms dataset",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Named Storms"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: storms_recent
#| cache: true
storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-wind-pressure
ggplot(storms_recent, aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Wind Speed and Air Pressure in Atlantic Storms",
    subtitle = "Stronger storms combine faster winds with lower pressure",
    x = "Wind Speed (knots)",
    y = "Air Pressure (millibars)",
    color = "Status"
  )
```
